title: SleepPro
body:
# 🌙 SleepPro
**The Lean & Mean Night Skipper.**

SleepPro is a lightweight, high-performance sleep plugin. No bloat, no complex setups—just a "Capped Percentage" logic that scales perfectly from 1 to 100 players.

## 🚀 Features
* **Capped Percentage Math:** Automatically calculates sleepers based on a percentage of active players.
* **Smart Scaling:** Set a minimum and maximum required count so your server never feels empty or impossible to skip.
* **Visual Progress:** Choose between a **Progressive BossBar** or a clean **ActionBar** to show how many players are in bed.
* **Anti-Cheese Logic:** 3-second countdown window that cancels if players jump out of bed last second.
* **EssentialsX & Vanish Integration:** Automatically ignores AFK and Vanished players to keep the math fair.
* **MiniMessage Support:** Full RGB and Gradient support for all messages.

## 🛠 Commands & Permissions
* `/sleeppro reload` - Reloads the configuration (Permission: `sleeppro.admin`)

## 📄 Configuration
SleepPro is designed to be "set and forget." Every message and logic variable is customizable in the `config.yml` and `messages.yml`.
